title: Verify one complete VOX flow through final export
description: Run one fresh configured-keychain VOX Simple Flow project through the documented scene, voice, subtitle, final preview, and final MP4 export checkpoints.
businessContext: The implementation now preserves approved scene media, produces voice/subtitles/preview, and leaves Preview Render reviewable. One fresh runtime is needed to provide truthful end-to-end evidence for final MP4 export.
acceptanceCriteria: The configured-keychain smoke creates the documented Vietnamese VOX topic project and persists the selected existing voice.
The smoke reaches idea selection, selective scene regeneration, scene approval, voice, Vietnamese subtitles, and a real Final Preview.
The smoke explicitly approves Final Preview and verifies a non-empty final MP4 export.
No provider, stage, media, approval, or export evidence is fabricated; failures are handed off with the exact persisted checkpoint.
humanEscalationConditions: The configured runtime cannot resolve a certified existing text, image, or voice path without bypassing a safety gate.
